_comment: Surfaces the prototype designed ahead of production that are too big to live
in src/ahead/ as a single component — whole pages, flows and tab sets.
They stay where they are; this file is what makes them show up in the
graduation check anyway, so nobody has to remember them.
`watchFor` lists the component names production would build if it took the
surface on. Every sync counts how many of them exist upstream: 0 means
still ours alone, all of them means our version is now a duplicate.
